report_metadata.report_title: SignBridge AI - Authentic ISL Dataset Availability & Legal Audit
report_metadata.auditor: Senior AI Systems Auditor & ISL Specialist

datasets.name: ISLRTC 10,000-Word ISL Dictionary & NDLI STEM Modules
datasets.organization: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC), DEPwD, Govt of India
datasets.signer_count: Multiple government-certified master Deaf signers and interpreters
datasets.annotation_format: English gloss, Hindi translation, formal definition, parts of speech
datasets.engineering_terminology_coverage: Moderate: Covers foundational science and basic computing (e.g. Computer, Voltage, Machine). Advanced specialized engineering concepts (e.g. Deadlock, Modulation, Bracing) are largely uncodified.
datasets.access_procedure: Searchable online at islrtc.nic.in, mobile app 'Sign Learn', National Digital Library of India (ndl.gov.in), and data.gov.in open catalogs
datasets.license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India) / Educational Fair Dealing
datasets.attribution_requirements: Mandatory citation: 'Source: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC), Government of India'
datasets.usability_verdict: USABLE_FOR_EDUCATIONAL_PILOT (Foundational STEM concepts only; attribution required)

datasets.name: ISLTranslate: Dataset for Translating Indian Sign Language
datasets.annotation_format: Continuous sentence-level English translations and gloss alignments
datasets.engineering_terminology_coverage: Low: Focused on general conversational and educational sentences, not university engineering coursework.
datasets.access_procedure: GitHub repository (Exploration-Lab/ISLTranslate) and Hugging Face Dataset Hub
datasets.attribution_requirements: Mandatory citation of ACL 2023 paper (Joshi, Agrawal, Modi)

datasets.name: INCLUDE: A Large Scale Dataset for Indian Sign Language Recognition
datasets.signer_count: Native Deaf students from St. Louis School for the Deaf, Chennai
datasets.annotation_format: CSV word labels, class index mappings, bounding boxes
datasets.engineering_terminology_coverage: Very Low: Covers basic vocabulary (colors, animals, actions); minimal tertiary engineering terminology.
datasets.access_procedure: Download script via AI4Bharat GitHub repository (github.com/AI4Bharat/INCLUDE)
datasets.license: Code: MIT; Dataset: Academic Research Non-Commercial Evaluation License
datasets.attribution_requirements: Mandatory academic citation of ACM MM 2020 paper (Sridhar et al.)

datasets.name: CISLR: Corpus for Indian Sign Language Recognition
datasets.signer_count: Multiple Deaf native signers and licensed interpreters
datasets.annotation_format: JSON metadata with one-shot ASL-proxy alignment vectors
datasets.engineering_terminology_coverage: Low-to-Moderate: Basic science and general vocabulary; specialized engineering terms absent.
datasets.attribution_requirements: Attribution to Exploration-Lab and original authors required

datasets.name: Sign Dictionary ISL
video_formats: MP4 (one gloss per video) + DWPose and MediaPipe Holistic pose files
datasets.annotation_format: JSON metadata (filename, transcripts, glosses, pose tensors)
datasets.engineering_terminology_coverage: Low: Contains basic technology words (Computer, Internet, Mobile), lacks university engineering terminology.
datasets.access_procedure: Publicly downloadable from Hugging Face WebDataset (bridgeconn/sign-dictionary-isl)
datasets.attribution_requirements: Attribution to Bridge Connectivity Solutions required under CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.usability_verdict: HIGHLY_USABLE (Open CC BY-SA 4.0 license with pre-extracted MediaPipe pose features)

gap_analysis.primary_data_strategy: Hybrid Approach: (1) Ingest foundational open-access ISLRTC/Bridgeconn clips with strict attribution. (2) Build an authorized in-house Recording Session workflow with certified Deaf master signers for advanced engineering terminology. (3) Enforce pedagogical fingerspelling and diagrams for uncodified technical concepts.
